blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Девицы, толкая друг друга, бросились в сени навстречу ___ (немощный враг).
exercises.why: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.
